h1: The 5 Best Orange Halloween Lights of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Orange Halloween Lights: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five orange and orange-purple Halloween string lights compared on bulb type, length, modes, connectability and outdoor use.
summary: The Hopolon Mini Orange incandescent set is our top pick for a true, warm orange that looks like classic Halloween. The Orange LED Outdoor lights are the best twinkle option at 39 feet, the weillsnow 500 LED is the long-run choice for roofs and trees, and the 20FT purple and orange set is the classic two-colour string.
intro: Orange is the hardest Halloween colour to get right in a string light. White LEDs behind an orange coating can look washed out or slightly yellow, while incandescent mini bulbs glow a warm, true orange that reads as pumpkin under a porch roof. The bulb type matters more than the wattage, because a cool LED in orange can turn a haunted porch into a traffic cone.

We ranked five sets that either say orange in the title or lead with orange and purple. We compared bulb type, stated length, lighting modes, whether the strings connect end to end and whether the listing says waterproof or UL certified. We did not count lumen claims, which these listings rarely print, and we kept the list short because only a handful of products state the colour.

products.name: Hopolon Mini Orange Halloween Lights
products.verdict: Incandescent orange mini lights that stay vivid and connect end to end.
products.description:
Hopolon sells incandescent mini lights in orange, and the listing says they stay lit with a vivid orange glow and connect end to end. Incandescent bulbs produce a warmer, more natural orange than LEDs, and the colour comes from the bulb itself.

It ranks first because it is the one set built entirely around orange and the traditional bulb type, whereas the others combine colours or rely on LED. The 20FT purple and orange set is also incandescent, but it splits its palette.

Best for a mantel, a doorway or wrapping a banister. The caveat is that incandescents run hotter and draw more power than LEDs, so keep them away from dry decorations and do not chain too many strings.
products.idealFor: Mantels, doorways and banisters that want classic orange.
products.skipIf: You want multi-mode LEDs or very long runs.

products.name: Orange LED Outdoor Halloween Lights
products.verdict: A 39 foot plug-in twinkle string with 8 flashing modes in orange.
products.description:
This orange LED set runs 39 feet, plugs into the wall and offers 8 flashing modes with a twinkle effect. At 39 feet it covers a porch rail or a large bush in one string.

It ranks second because it is a pure orange LED set with enough length and effect options for outdoors, but the incandescent Hopolon has the warmer glow. It beats the purple combinations for anyone wanting orange only.

Suits railings, fences and shrubs. The caveat is that the listing's wording is thin, with no stated waterproof rating, so use a weather-rated outlet cover.
cons: Colour may read cooler than incandescent
products.skipIf: You need a documented weatherproof rating.

products.name: weillsnow 500 LED Halloween Lights Outdoor, 164 FT Twinkle Lights Waterproof
products.verdict: A 164 ft, 500 LED low-voltage orange and purple string with 8 modes and memory.
products.description:
This set packs 500 LEDs on 164 feet of wire, runs on 29V low voltage and mixes orange with purple, with 8 modes, a memory function and a waterproof rating. Low voltage matters outdoors because it reduces shock risk on wet nights.

It ranks third because it is only partly orange, a blend with purple, while the Hopolon and Orange LED sets are pure orange. It wins on length, which lets one string cover a tree or a roofline.

Best for large outdoor builds. The caveat is that the purple mix softens the orange effect, and 164 feet is a lot of wire to tidy.
products.idealFor: Trees, rooflines and large outdoor displays.
products.skipIf: You want a pure orange look.

products.name: 20FT 100Ct Purple Orange Halloween Lights for Outdoor Indoor Decorations
products.verdict: A UL-certified 20 ft incandescent string of 100 purple and orange bulbs.
products.description:
This string has 100 incandescent bulbs in purple and orange on 20 feet, connects end to end and carries UL certification. UL certification means the set was evaluated against a recognized electrical safety standard.

It ranks fourth because the palette is shared between two colours and it offers fewer bulbs per foot than a long LED run. It wins on the stated UL certificate, which the other sets do not mention.

A good fit for indoor mantels and covered porches. The caveat is that incandescents run hot, so avoid wrapping them around paper decorations.
products.idealFor: Mantels and covered porches that want two colours.
products.skipIf: You want only orange or very long runs.

products.name: TW SHINE Purple and Orange Halloween Lights
products.verdict: Purple and orange lights that extend end to end for building longer runs.
products.description:
TW SHINE offers a purple and orange set that is described as charming and extends end to end. Being extendable means you can add strings to cover a larger area without a second outlet, up to the maker's limit.

It ranks last because the listing gives no bulb count, length or mode data, while the other sets provide at least some. It stays as a reasonable two-colour option for those who prefer this brand.

Good for a modest porch display you may expand next year. The caveat is the thin listing, so confirm the string length and maximum connected strings before ordering.
products.idealFor: Modest porch displays you may expand later.
products.skipIf: You want stated length, modes or ratings.

whatMatters.detail: Incandescent minis glow a warm orange that looks authentic, while LEDs stay cooler, last longer and use less power. The same orange coating looks different on each. Check whether the listing says incandescent or LED, and match the type to the look you want and the heat your decorations can take.

Many Halloween sets pair orange with purple or green. A mixed set only gives you part of the string in orange. Look for orange in the title without a second colour, and read the bulb count to see how many of the bulbs are actually orange.

A 20 foot string covers a mantel, and 164 feet can wrap a tree. Bulb count controls how dense the glow looks. Measure the area you plan to light, and compare it with the stated length, allowing extra for corners and drops.

A 29V low-voltage set is safer outdoors than a mains-voltage string, and UL certification means an independent safety standard was applied. Neither is common on cheap sets. Look for the voltage or UL mention, and avoid chaining more strings than the maker allows.

Eight modes let you choose steady, twinkle or flash, and a memory function restores your choice after a power cut. Without memory, the set resets to the first mode. Check the listing for the mode count and memory, especially if you use a timer.

faq.q: How many strings can I connect?
faq.a: It depends on the set. The 20FT purple and orange incandescents and the Hopolon connect end to end, but each has a maximum. Check the packaging, because overloading a chain can overheat the first string's wiring.

faq.q: What mistake do people make with orange lights?
faq.a: Choosing a cool LED and expecting warm pumpkin orange. The Orange LED set is bright and clean, but the Hopolon incandescents give a warmer glow. Look at photos in the dark, not just in daylight.

faq.q: Is the weillsnow worth more than the Hopolon?
faq.a: If you need length. The weillsnow covers 164 feet with 500 LEDs and low voltage, but it mixes orange with purple. The Hopolon is the better pure orange for small areas.

faq.q: How do I hang lights outdoors?
faq.a: Use clips or hooks instead of staples, route cords away from standing water and plug into a weather-rated outlet cover. The weillsnow waterproof rating helps, but connections still need protection.

faq.q: How do I store them for next year?
faq.a: Wrap each string around a cardboard tube or a reel, and keep the bulbs from rubbing. Incandescent sets like the Hopolon and 20FT have more fragile bulbs, so store them in a rigid box.

faq.q: Can I use these on a timer?
faq.a: Yes, with an outlet timer on plug-in sets. The weillsnow memory function restores its mode after power returns, which helps. Without memory, the set returns to the first mode every evening.

finalTake: The Hopolon Mini Orange set is the best orange Halloween light here because incandescent bulbs give the warmest, truest pumpkin glow. The Orange LED Outdoor lights are the better twinkle for rails and shrubs, and the weillsnow is the long-run pick for trees. Choose bulb type before length.
